title: Software Engineer (New Grad)
job_desc:
Software Engineer, New Grad 2026 - Fieldnote (San Jose, CA)
Fieldnote builds mobile and web tools for field service teams. Join our new grad program.
You will: build features across our React frontend and Python / Java services; write REST APIs and SQL; write tests and review code; debug production issues with your team; learn our cloud stack (AWS).
Requirements: B.S. in Computer Science or related (2026 grad); strong data structures and algorithms; at least one of Python, Java or JavaScript; internship or substantial project experience; Git; clear communication.

interview.question: Tell me about a bug that was hard to find and how you fixed it.
interview.answer: In my internship there was a bug in the data pipeline. I looked through the code and found the problem and fixed it. It took a while.
